elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code showing import of norm from scipy.stats, defining variables x=68000, mean=60000, standard_deviation=7500, and using round(1 - norm.cdf(x, mean, standard_deviation), 3) to calculate the probability that a random employee earns more than $68,000.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates how to use the norm.cdf() function in Python to calculate the probability that a value exceeds a certain threshold in a normal distribution, specifically for employee salaries.
